---
name: Public feature or module proposal
about: Suggest a ZLife improvement, workflow, module idea, or community direction
---

## Problem or opportunity

What real problem should ZLife solve, or what opportunity should it pursue?

## Who benefits?

Describe the people, businesses, contributors, or workflows affected.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the result you want. Focus on the user outcome before implementation details.

## ZLife area

Choose one or more: `ZLife Core`, `Tree Service`, `AI Assistant`, `Web Builder`, `App Builder`, `Business`, `Home`, `Money`, `Family`, `Auto`, `Documents`, `Health`, `Travel`, `Learning`, `Services`, `Community`, `New module idea`.

## Why it belongs in ZLife

Explain how this reduces fragmentation, improves a connected workflow, helps users grow, or strengthens the community-built platform.

## Suggested scope

What is the smallest useful first version?

## Risks or constraints

Call out privacy, permissions, payments, AI usage, security, legal, accessibility, or infrastructure concerns you can already see.

## Contribution interest

- [ ] I would like to help design this.
- [ ] I would like to help build this.
- [ ] I would like to help test this.
- [ ] I am submitting the idea only.

## Public-data check

- [ ] This proposal contains no production secrets, private customer data, passwords, tokens, payment information, or confidential business information.

Community proposals can influence ZLife direction, but submission does not create employment, ownership, equity, compensation, or guaranteed roadmap priority.
